plain.h2: What you get, in plain terms.
plain.p: We put AI to work where it helps you sell: answering customer questions, collecting their details, booking calls and drafting follow-ups. It works from your business's information, follows your rules, and passes the conversation to a person when it should.

inc.h2: Where we put AI to work.

items.p: On WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and your website. It answers questions about your products, services, prices and opening hours, in your tone.
It works from the information you approve: your services, your prices, your policies. When it doesn't know, it says so and calls a person.
It asks the questions your team would ask, records the answers in your CRM, and books a call or an appointment.

items.h: A clean hand-off to your team
items.p: When a customer needs a person, the conversation goes to the right member of your team, with the full history.
AI drafts follow-up messages from what each customer asked, for your team to check and send.
We use AI in our own studio to make visuals and video for your posts and ads faster. A person checks everything before it goes out.

steps.p: We look at your messages and your sales process, and pick the jobs AI does well. Not everything should be automated.

steps.h: We write what it knows and its rules
steps.p: What it can say, what it must never say, and when it must hand over to a person. You approve all of it.
To WhatsApp, your website, your pages and your CRM.
We ask it the questions your customers ask, and the awkward ones too, before any customer sees it.
We read the conversations, fill the gaps and keep its information up to date.

choose.h2: How to choose an AI chatbot partner in Mauritius.

items.h: Ask what it will be trained on
items.p: An assistant is only as good as the information it works from. Ask who writes and approves it, and how it is kept up to date.

items.h: Ask what happens when it doesn't know
items.p: A good assistant hands the conversation to a person. A bad one guesses. Ask to see how the hand-off works.

items.h: Check it connects to your sales
items.p: An assistant that chats but doesn't record enquiries or book calls leaves the job half done. It should feed your CRM and your calendar.
Before launch, ask it the questions your customers ask, and the awkward ones too. If the answers worry you, it isn't ready.

fl.h2: The first reply every customer gets.
fl.p: In Fledge, the AI assistant works inside your CRM. Every conversation is saved, every booking lands in your calendar, and every enquiry is followed up, whether it came in at noon or at midnight.
